inbox.messaging.DelegationEntry.title: DelegationEntry
inbox.messaging.DelegationEntry.description: One delegation of the key file: until `valid_until`, `agent` may speak for `on_behalf_of` in every message it sends, and act as the owner of the inbox whose address has the text of `on_behalf_of` in every request that names that inbox. Version 1 has no narrower scope and no chain. The operator key signs the entry.

operator_signature.description: The operator key's Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the other fields of the entry, in base64.

inbox.messaging.DelegationId.title: DelegationId
inbox.messaging.DelegationId.description: The id of a delegation that lets `from` speak for `on_behalf_of`. The SignatureVerifier port resolves it; the inbox stores no delegation.

inbox.messaging.Principal.title: Principal
inbox.messaging.Principal.description: Who sends, or whose word a message is: `agent:<host>/<session-name>` or `human:<name>`. The SignatureVerifier port decides which key speaks for which principal.
